mapper.select: SELECT user_id,status,required_level FROM article_info WHERE article_id=#{articleId} AND deleted=0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT user_id FROM user_info WHERE user_id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT user_id,status,required_level FROM article_info WHERE article_id=#{articleId} AND deleted=0

SELECT CAST(l.id AS CHAR) AS id,CAST(l.admin_user_id AS CHAR) AS adminUserId,u.nick_name AS adminName,l.action,CAST(l.target_id AS CHAR) AS targetId,l.before_value AS beforeValue,l.after_value AS afterValue,l.reason,l.details_json AS detailsJson,l.created_at AS createdAt FROM admin_operation_log l LEFT JOIN user_info u ON u.user_id=l.admin_user_id ORDER BY l.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article_revision r LEFT JOIN article_info a ON a.article_id=r.article_id WHERE r.state=1 AND r.deleted=0 AND (a.article_id IS NULL OR a.deleted=0)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article_info WHERE status=2 AND deleted=0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article_info WHERE status=1 AND deleted=0 AND required_level>0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article_info WHERE status=1 AND deleted=0

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article_info a LEFT JOIN user_info u ON u.user_id=a.user_id WHERE a.deleted=0 AND a.status IN(1,2) AND (a.title LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR u.nick_name LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!') AND a.status=#{status}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_info u LEFT JOIN user_reading_progress p ON p.user_id=u.user_id WHERE u.nick_name LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR CAST(u.user_id AS CHAR) LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!'

SELECT CAST(u.user_id AS CHAR) AS userId,u.nick_name AS nickName,u.role,CAST(u.status AS UNSIGNED) AS status,u.join_time AS joinTime,COALESCE(p.total_millis,0) DIV 1000 AS readingSeconds,GREATEST(COALESCE(p.earned_level,0),COALESCE((SELECT MAX(level) FROM reading_level_rule WHERE min_seconds<=COALESCE(p.total_millis,0) DIV 1000),0)) AS readingLevel FROM user_info u LEFT JOIN user_reading_progress p ON p.user_id=u.user_id WHERE u.nick_name LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR CAST(u.user_id AS CHAR) LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' ORDER BY u.join_time DESC,u.user_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
